items.reason: Owner authorizes separate personal Home reached from Main Hub. Free persisted display choices reuse current weapon icon / accepted recipe-scroll and trophy art / clear display. Hub NPCs and public stations remain in Hub; no tint identity changes, currency or paid decoration mechanics.

external_art_requirement.state: empty furnished room background; no baked actors/pets, UI or text
external_art_requirement.required_pose: Room has a clear standing/follower floor, furniture/perch and wall display space; no public Hub NPCs/stations. Keep current approved architectural/material language.
external_art_requirement.occupied_bounds: Full bleed background; protect UI zones y<240 and y>1900. Keep floor beneath actor baseline y1823 in this canvas.
external_art_requirement.pivot: Background top-left; uniform cover scaling preserves aspect ratio
external_art_requirement.layers: Empty furnished background; optional separate perch/shelf/shadow layers. Characters, pets, reward items, UI and transient lights remain separate.
external_art_requirement.why_existing_source_cannot_close: Approved Home panel is landscape, low-resolution and baked with all six companion bodies. Cropping/erasing them cannot produce complete empty furniture/floor pixels; cannot show unequipped pets or call this a finished room.
